categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server initialization and bind handling in src/httpserver.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents local RPC credential leakage caused by bitcoind failing open when only IPv6 binds. When IPv4 loopback is occupied, bitcoin-cli defaults to IPv4 and sends plaintext cookie credentials to a rogue process, presenting a critical security issue for node authentication.
